de1.P1.C10.ly_do: Tong cac goc trong mot tu giac la $360^\circ$ (phuong an B) dung.

de1.P1.C12.ghi_chu: Can hinh 1 goc de doi chieu: thu muc anh local cua bai rong (khong co image4.png), khong biet goc vuong cua tam giac ABC o dinh nao nen khong xac minh duoc dang thuc $BC^2 = AB^2 + AC^2$ (phuong an A). Khong doan.

de1.P4.C1.ly_do: a) $5x(2x-3y) = 10x^2-15xy$ (phuong an 3) dung. b) $(x+y)^2+(x+y)(x-y)-5x^2 = -3x^2+2xy$ (phuong an 3) dung; loi giai AI y b da duoc duyet, dung.
